unresolved_items: TLC-UB-LDA-006: G operator domain/codomain — Domains, codomains and concrete semantics of g_i in G are not supplied.
TLC-UB-LDA-007: generator composition typing — Intermediate types required for g_k(...g_1(N_min)...) are not specified.
TLC-UB-LDA-008: generator-sequence construction — The source asserts existence but gives no search or construction procedure.
TLC-UB-LDA-009: generator ordering — No rule selects or orders a generating sequence.
TLC-UB-LDA-010: generator length k — No minimality, bound or selection rule for k is supplied.
TLC-UB-LDA-011: generative closure and complexity — Closure properties and complexity of generation are not established.
required_behavior: Preserve the existential claim that each x in N_inv can be generated from N_min by a finite sequence of operators from G.
forbidden_behavior: Do not invent a search procedure, minimal k, closure theorem, solver, ordering rule, or complexity bound.
